cards.lore: The Osmotic-Anchor. Fixing Hypo-Nats too fast = Osmotic-Demyelination Syndrome (aka Kayfaboggle).
cards.power: The Water-Warp. Pulls Water-Tokens whenever he goes. The high Sodium is a Mimic: whatever it does with fluid, Osmolality has already noted it.

cards.lore: Hyper-K-the-Killer creates Peaked-T-Wave-Mountains. Hypo-K-Nail opens the Valley. Beware of Error.
cards.power: The Voltage-Trigger. Controls the Resting-Heart of heart wires. Off Balance? The Heart gets confused.

cards.lore: Regulated by Parathyroid-Hormone. If Mag-the-Magnet is low, Calcium won't rise.
cards.power: The Membrane-Stabilizer. Keeps Nerve-Gates steady. Hypo-Cal = Gates Slamming, Hyper-Cal = Gates shut.

cards.lore: Low Mag triggers Torsade-de-Told. The Ignored-Electrolyte causing Mystery-Glitches.
cards.power: The Gatekeeper's-Helper. The Universal-Relaxer holding the Potassium/Calcium gates shut.

cards.lore: The Cargo-Ship. Without Iron-Bolts, the ship can't carry oxygen-crates.
cards.power: The Oxygen-Tank. Determines available Breath-Fuel. Dark color = low Hemoglobin = fainting from Cargo-Penalty.

cards.lore: Too high = Clot-the-Blocker. Beware-HIT-the-Hunter is in the ICU!
cards.power: The Hole-Sealer. First-Responders to a Leak-Crisis. Low count (Thrombo-the-Thin) = bleeding from scratches.

cards.lore: Neutrophils fight bacteria. Eosinophils fight Parasite-Punks and Allergy-Killjoys.
cards.power: The Riot-Scanner. High (Leuko-the-High) = Infection-Incursion. A Left-Shift shows massive Peaked-Battalions deployed or Intranuclear-Rookie (bands).

cards.lore: Micro-Mitch = Iron-Deficiency. Macro-Max = B12 or Folate-Famine.
cards.power: The Cell-Architect. Tells the Detective if Red-Cells are big (Macro-Mix) or small (Micro-Misfit).

cards.lore: A late indicator. If Kidney-Gears have already seized up, Creatinine is already mixed up.
cards.power: The Filter-Score. The Trash-Count in the blood. Rising score = Kidney-Filters are clogged/failing.

cards.lore: Rises when thirsty, or if Hank-Builder is hiding in the GI tract (Protein-loading).
cards.power: The Dehydration-Signal. When ratio > 20, shows the wrestler is Fluid-Starved.

cards.lore: Calculated from Area/Age/Gender. If GFR < 15, it's Dialysis-Time.
cards.power: The Clearance-Clock. How fast the body can Flush-the-Toxins and clear-the-Mold.

cards.lore: A stable Trash-Marker produced constantly by all nucleated cells.
cards.power: The Precise-Scan. For wrestlers too Sarcopenic-Thin or Bodybuilder-Buff for a standard Area-check.

cards.lore: The Liver-Sentry. Thousands of units = something Catastrophic from Toxic-Assault or Viral-Vandalism.
cards.power: The Cell-Burst-Signal. High ALT = Liver-Cells are smashing their Chemical-Guts into the bloodstream.

cards.lore: Also spikes in Heart-Hall and Muscle-Meltdown rhapsody.
cards.power: The Multi-Damage-Marker. Less specific than ALT. If AST is much higher than ALT, think Al-the-Alcoholic-Wrecking-Blow.

cards.lore: Low Albumin causes Edema-the-Swelling because the Water-Magnet is gone.
cards.power: The Chronic-Status-Bar. Built by the liver; a low score means the Factory-is-Broken or falling for weeks.

cards.lore: The Waste-Product of hemoglobin. High Direct Bili means clogged Bile-Grime-and-Bile-Spool.
cards.power: The Jaundice-Flow. High indicates the hamster-wheels are exploding. Bilirubin-cells are absolutely yellow-tinted.

cards.lore: The Molecular-Skeleton. If it's in the blood, the cell membrane has been fatally breached.
cards.power: The Refusal-Toolkit. The Gold-Standard proof that Cardio-Cell-Membranes are actively dying.

cards.lore: Differentiates Lung-Mist-Pneumonia from Heart-Failure-Flood.
cards.power: The Flood-Warning. When heart-walls Stretch from too much fluid, BNP yells at kidneys to Dump-the-Water.

cards.lore: Troponin stays high for days. CK-MB is the Short-Term-Witness.
cards.power: The Time-Witness. Disappears fast. Used to see if the wrestler is having a second heart attack right after the first.

cards.lore: The Scraps of a Fibrin clot. It is a Screen, never a Diagnosis.
cards.power: The Clot-Rule-Out. Low D-Dimer = NO clot. High means something is breaking down (Infection, Trauma, or Clot).

cards.lore: Liver failure raises INR because the sick liver can't build Factor-V-the-Key.
cards.power: The Thin-Check. Warfarin High-the-Old-Guard. High INR = High Bleed-Risk.

cards.lore: Measures the Intrinsic-and-Common-Highways.
cards.power: The Speed-Limit. Monitors Heparin-the-Gravy. Too high = bleed note like Water-Iguana.

cards.lore: The vital Raw-Material for the Fibrin-Mesh.
cards.power: The Resource-Count. Without it, Platelet-Plugs can't stick. In DIC-the-Disaster, the supply is Consumed to zero.

cards.lore: Used in Obese-Wrestlers or Renal-Fail-Days to verify dose safety.
cards.power: The X-Ray-Vision. Tracks Factor-X-Inhibitors when standard PT/aPTT are completely blind to them.

cards.lore: The Pituitary-Sentry is always watching.
cards.power: The Feedback-Loop. High TSH = Brain screaming at a Sleepy-Then-Thyroid. Low TSH = Thyroid is Over-Driven.

cards.lore: Binds itself to the Red-Cell-Inventory for its full 120-day lifespan.
cards.power: The Cheat-Detector. Reveals Average-Sugar-State over 90 days. You can't fake a Fling-From-Diets from Average-Sugar-State.

cards.lore: Fight-or-Flight. Caveat: High ICU stress artificially spikes this stat.
cards.power: The Survival-Fuel. Zero = Addison-the-Crash (Shock). Too high = Cushing-the-Corb (Obesity/Thin skin).

cards.lore: Type 1 Diabetics have ZERO C-Peptide. Insulinoma-Ian has massive amounts.
cards.power: The Origin-Finder. Proves if blood insulin was Home-Made (Pancreas) or Injected (Syringe).

cards.lore: Normal pH = Balanced Bella. Low pH + High pCO2 = Lung-over-Lazy (Respiratory Acidosis).
cards.power: The Living-Truth. Tells exactly how well Lung-Balloons exchange air and if blood is going Acid or Base.

cards.lore: High Lactate = Sepsis-Alert. The body is burning without oxygen at the cellular engine level.
cards.power: The Starvation-Counter. High Lactate = Cell-Engines are starving for oxygen. Burning Emergency-Fuel.

cards.lore: MUDPILES. The Gap tells you precisely what kind of acid is ruining the match.
cards.power: The Mystery-Acid-Finder. High Gap = a Hidden-Acid-Saboteur is in the blood (Ketoacids, Lactic, Toxins).

cards.lore: The Cherry-Red wrestler. The standard hGy-Sensor is totally fooled into thinking blood is 100% oxygenated.
cards.power: The Silent-Suffocator. CO hitches a ride on the Red-Cell-Inventory, permanently blocking oxygen from boarding.

cards.lore: An Acute-Phase-Reactant. Doesn't say where the fire is, just that the Immune-Army is mobilising.
cards.power: The Fire-Alarm. Rises fast during Bam-Sepsis or a Joint-Riot. Confirms the Battle is Active.

cards.lore: Inflammation makes red cells stick together and Sink-Fast in a test tube.
cards.power: The Slow-Burn-Tracker. Spikes in chronic Auto-Immune-Wars like Lupus-Larry. The Old-School-Inflammation-Clock.

cards.lore: The ultimate weapon to help the team stop Antibiotic-Overuse.
cards.power: The Antibiotic-Cue. High = Bacterial-Punks are present. Low = it's just a Viral-Rascal.

cards.lore: Sterile-Technique is vital. If Skin-Steward-Staph gets into the bottle, it's a False-Alarm.
cards.power: The Positive-Identification. Tells the team the exact Name-and-Weapon of the bacteria in the Blood-Highway.

cards.lore: Not 100% specific. A massive BPH-Benign-Giant also raises the score.
cards.power: The Giant-Guard. High PSA = Prostate-Towers are inflamed (Prostatitis) or under siege by Malignant-Max.

cards.lore: A rise after surgery = the Shadow-Malignancy is creeping back.
cards.power: The Recurrence-Radar. Not for finding cancer initially, but watching if it returns after the Blade-Brigade removes it.

cards.lore: Any physical irritation of the peritoneal lining can artificially raise this above normal.
cards.power: The Peritoneal-Patrol. A Follow-up tool. Also triggers for Endo-Ball and Fibroid-Fiona.

cards.lore: Dual-use: Also the marker for Fetal-Neural-Tube-Leaks in the Gyn-field.
cards.power: The Mass-Classifier. If Liver-the-Livy has a lump + high AFP, it's likely Malignant-Max.

cards.lore: Nitrite + Leukocyte = Bacteria-the-Punks are absolutely present.
cards.power: The Quick-Urine-Scan. Reveals a Bladder-Riot (UTI). Sugar-Leak = Diabetes exploiting the Filter-Overflow.

cards.lore: The very first clinical sign of Diabetic-Nephropathy.
cards.power: The Diabetic-Kidney-Sentinel. Finds the Tiny-Protein-Leaks long before the standard dipstick can see them.

cards.lore: Only detects human blood. No Red-Meat-Interference to cause false alarms.
cards.power: The Hidden-Bleed-Finder. Locates Invisible-Hank-the-Haemorrhage in the gut (early sign of Carci-Cure-All).

cards.lore: Drawing the sacred liquor of the soul to check the inner sanctum.
cards.power: The Brain-Bunker-Report. Differentiates Bacterial-Mist (low sugar, high protein) from Viral-Vandalism (normal sugar).

cards.lore: The chemical culprit behind Asterixis (the Flapping Hand-Tremor).
cards.power: The Toxic-Cloud. If Liver-the-Limp fails, Ammonia builds up and triggers Encephalopathy-GI-Confusion/Coma.

cards.lore: The definitive hallmark of Acute Pancreatitis.
cards.power: The AutoDigestion-Alarm. When Lipase is >3x normal, the Pancreas-Factory is literally Eating-Itself.

cards.lore: The painful end-product of Purine metabolism.
cards.power: The Crystal-Slayer. High levels precipitate into Needles that ruthlessly stab the joints and the Kidney-Filters.

cards.lore: Caveat: During a Systemic-Riot, the body locks the Iron in the vault. Ferritin will look Falsely-High.
cards.power: The Inventory-Check. Proves if the Iron-Bolts are truly fasting (Anemia-Ansia) or just hidden away.

cards.lore: Hypokalemia makes the heart wires Hyper-Sensitive to Digoxin's poison.
cards.power: The Cardiac-Gamble. Level > 2.0 = Dig-Tox-Ian appears, causing Yellow-Vision and heart blocks.

cards.lore: Treatment relies entirely on the N-Acetyl-Cysteine-Rescue.
cards.power: The Liver-Destiny. Predicts if the wrestler survives the overdose or if the liver-Factory is mathematically doomed.

cards.lore: Competes directly with Sodium in the Kidney-Filters.
cards.power: The Mind-Stabilizer. Too low = Barry-Bipolar swings. Too high = The-Shakes-and-Tremors + Renal-Failure.

cards.lore: Cleared at an absolute, unchangeable constant rate of 15-20 mg/dL per hour.
cards.power: The CNS-Depressor. Decodes why the wrestler is unconscious. Is it The-Drink-Or-Metabolic (Ketoacidosis)?

cards.lore: The patient is the test; the lab is the subtext. Trust the numbers, but always verify the clinical fit. Stay fluffy!
cards.power: The Data-Validator.

cards.lore: A wrestler with Renal-Ray-Failure is found with a heart rate of 50. The ECG shows massive Peaked-Mountains.
A diabetic wrestler arrives unconscious. Bella says pH is 7.0, and the Anion-Gap is exactly 25.
Wrestler has yellow skin, dark urine, pale stools. Lab reveals High-Direct-Bilirubin and High-Lipase.

title: Laboratory Medicine Wrestling: The Numerical Noir & The Biomarker Betrayal
